findings.note: MLB.com's Game 3 preview leaves Max Muncy out of the projected Dodgers lineup (Kiké Hernández at 3B, Miguel Rojas at 2B), says Ohtani (right biceps, left knee) and Freeman (right knee) are playing through lingering injuries, and notes Snell walked five in his first playoff start.

Covers analyst Quinn Allen picks the Dodgers moneyline for Game 3 (no total pick), pointing to how dominant Snell is at home and against Milwaukee, while saying Gasser has had trouble with the Dodgers lineup; probable starters are Gasser (2.25 ERA) vs Snell (2.46 ERA).

MLB.com's rotation preview notes Gasser has a 5.91 ERA in two career starts against the Dodgers, though it also cites his 1.67 ERA over his last six regular-season outings and high confidence, which cuts against the over.
